entries.zh: 长久心计、耐性〔词头残疑，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头「delos S.Sau[疑]o uen~」后半无法定解，且 H 橈与 M 栏 gui 不合，仅長心（tiang sim）可据，取「长久心计/耐性」义存疑。

entries.en: foresight; prudent calculation for what lies ahead
wise, one who governs well; brilliant and able
expedient and adaptable; one who knows how to size up matters
one who knows the weight of things; discerning, able to gauge matters
having expedient judgment; one who knows when to withdraw as occasion demands
one who knows the proper measure; knows what is to be done
a capable, sensible person; prudent and resourceful
to publish, proclaim; to make manifest
entries.notes: H 栏「piau」与 M 栏后段（hiun rang hien iau）未能定解，仅据 hien=顯 与 Publicar 定义。

entries.en: to shine forth; to glorify, make resplendent

entries.notes: R 栏残损、M 栏复合词（iang boñ / iang chiong id）未能定解，据 H 揚与 publicar 取宣扬传扬义，低置信。

entries.en: to display, perform publicly; to elaborate
to shine, flaunt; to make illustrious

entries.notes: L 词头 p̃o 残损、H 与 R 栏皆空，M iang po yañ 不足定解，拒产确定释义。
